metadata.title: The RFxchange™
metadata.description: A map-based business growth network for capability discovery, opportunities, referrals, partnerships, resources, and measured activity.
metadata.openGraphDescription: Make business capability, opportunity, and connection easier to discover and act on.

footer.summary: A local business growth network that helps organizations be found, find opportunity, and build the right connections.

hero.eyebrow: A Local Business Growth Network · By Accel Analysis
hero.titleBefore: The local market is already moving.
hero.summary: The RFxchange helps organizations describe what they do, become easier to discover, and move into opportunities, referrals, teaming, and support as those features become available.
hero.evidenceNote: Images are illustrative unless otherwise identified.

availability.title: See what you can use today—and what is coming next.
availability.description: Current features and upcoming product pathways are identified separately.

items.title: Establish your organization
items.detail: Create an account, choose your location, find or add your organization, confirm its details, add a meaningful capability, and finish setup.

items.title: Become visible on the map
items.detail: Once setup is complete, your organization appears on the Exchange map at its confirmed or privacy-safe location.

items.title: Discover more of the Exchange
items.detail: Capability search, organization discovery, referrals, resource providers, and additional Exchange views are becoming available over time.

items.title: Move through RFx and outcomes
items.detail: RFx response workflows, credibility information, and outcome tracking expand what organizations can do from the Exchange.

live.title: Put your organization on the map.
live.description: Setup connects your account, organization, location, and capabilities so others can find you for relevant reasons.

steps.title: Create the account
steps.detail: Create your sign-in and accept the platform terms.

steps.title: Select the locality
steps.detail: Tell us where your organization is based.

steps.title: Resolve the organization
steps.detail: Find your organization or add it if it is not listed.

steps.title: Confirm the location
steps.detail: Confirm the location shown on the map and use a privacy-safe option when available.

steps.title: Describe one capability
steps.detail: Add at least one capability that helps others understand what your organization can do.

steps.title: Enter the Exchange
steps.detail: Finish setup and enter the Exchange workspace.

model.title: One market environment. From visibility to action.
model.description: Organizations, opportunities, connections, workflows, and outcomes come together in one Exchange. Features appear as they become available.
model.label: How the Exchange works

steps.title: Organization
steps.detail: Show what your organization does and where it operates.

steps.title: Opportunity
steps.detail: Business needs and RFx opportunities provide context for action.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.detail: Explore potential fit without treating it as qualification or endorsement.

steps.title: Relationship
steps.detail: Referrals, teams, and providers connect organizations around a specific need.

steps.title: Workflow
steps.detail: Take the next action available for that opportunity or connection.

steps.title: Outcome
steps.detail: Record outcomes when the supporting workflow and information are available.

difference.eyebrow: A living market—not a conventional dashboard
difference.title: Built around organizations, geography, and business action.

items.label: More than a directory
items.detail: Organizations can be discovered by capability, geography, and business context, then carry that context into opportunities and connections.

items.label: Not a social feed
items.detail: The RFxchange focuses on organizations, capabilities, geography, and business workflows—not follower counts or general posting.

items.label: Broader than a bid portal
items.detail: RFx belongs inside a wider business network that also connects capabilities, resources, referrals, and intelligence.

connection.title: Context should travel with the participant.
connection.description: The Exchange is designed to keep the reason for a connection attached as you move from discovery into referrals, teaming, resources, and RFx activity.

audience.title: A practical environment for the people who move local business.

items.name: Economic developers + civic leaders
items.detail: See participating organizations and capabilities in geographic context, then use expanding resource and market activity tools as they become available.

items.name: Businesses
items.detail: Establish your organization and capabilities, then use Exchange workflows to discover and act on relevant connections.

items.name: Resource providers
items.detail: Connect services to the business needs and service areas they are designed to support.

evidence.title: Clear signals, clear limits.
evidence.description: The RFxchange distinguishes confirmed information, participant-provided information, and features that are not yet available.
rules: Illustrative images are identified as such.
Tutorial examples are kept separate from Exchange records.
Features that are not yet available are labeled as planned or in development.
Public opportunity information does not provide private access.
Verification and outcomes appear only when the required information exists.
